LETTER AGREEMENT - HOSPITAL SERVICES RATES AND
TERMS
Date: 20th day of September, 2025
This letter agreement sets out how Evergreen Health Partners (the Plan) will reimburse Larkspur Women's
Health Center (the Provider) for covered services given to the Plan's members. It replaces the parties' earlier
arrangement dated September 20, 2022, under which clean claims were paid within 60 days and acute
inpatient care was paid at $3,600 per day. Those earlier terms no longer apply.
Rates. Starting on 20th day of September, 2025, the Plan will pay a flat per diem of $3,750 for each day of
acute medical/surgical inpatient care, and one hundred sixty (160) percent of the Medicare fee schedule for
general outpatient services. Behavioral health inpatient stays are paid at $4,050 per day, and emergency
department visits at 175 percent of Medicare.

Payment and filing. The Plan will pay each clean claim within forty-five (45) days after it receives the claim.
The Provider must send claims no later than three hundred sixty-five (365) days after the date of service. A
denied claim may be appealed within 210 days.
Credentialing. The Plan will finish credentialing the Provider's clinicians within forty-five (45) days of
getting a complete application.
Duration. This letter agreement begins on the 20th day of September, 2025, runs for four years, and ends on
the 19th day of September, 2029. It will not roll over; a new signed agreement is needed to continue after
that date. Either side may end it early, without cause, by giving one hundred eighty (180) days written
notice.

Law. This letter agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Florida.
Insurance and records. The Provider will carry professional liability cover of $2,000,000 per occurrence and
keep records for 10 years.
Please countersign below to confirm that this reflects our agreement.
